message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crime(s). Facts: Defendant Chen damaged a loader and a diesel engine of a sand mining operation, using hammer, causing damage valued 32,601 RMB. He did it intentionally out of personal grievance. This is destruction of property. Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 275 (破坏交通工具、公共设施、生产经营设备、邮电设施、广播电视设施、供水供电设施、燃气设施、供热设施、供热设施、供热设施? Actually article 275: "故意毁坏公私财物，数额较大" is crime of "故意毁坏财物罪". The statutory name is "故意毁坏财物". The instruction: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "故意毁坏财物". Not "故意毁坏财物罪". Also need to consider if any other crime like "寻衅滋事"? He used hammer to damage property due to grievance, but primary is property damage. The amount is 32,601 RMB, which is "数额较大". So crime: "故意毁坏财物". No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
